composition_subtypes.role: Sort odd piles by middle card value descending to order greedy picks.
Iterate over sorted odd piles, taking middle card in alternating turns starting with player1.

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort odd piles by middle value, then greedily assign middle cards in alternating turns.
payload.rationale: Even piles split evenly; odd piles sorted descending by middle card so player whose turn gets larger middle, alternating turns.
